title: ICON Vulcan
description: Documented public construction 3D printer (ICON) for the Autonomous Construction Coordinator capability area.
body:
ICON Vulcan is a documented construction 3D printer from ICON. Large-scale 3D printer building code-compliant homes layer by layer; printed communities in Texas and Mexico.

How it works: It works by computing the lawnmower path: ceil(width / swath) passes times the field depth, plus turn segments.

Documented uses of this capability area include warehouse automation fleets, surgical robotics, autonomous laboratories, drone delivery networks, and subsea exploration.
